'''Tatrang III''' was a [[Poison/Legends|poisonous]] [[Jungle/Legends|jungle]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] with three [[Moon/Legends|moons]] that was located within the [[Tatrang system]],<ref name="PotG2" /> a part of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Tammuz sector/Legends|Tammuz sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It occupied the third closest [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] around the [[Star system/Legends|system's]] [[Star/Legends|star]], the [[Red giant/Legends|red giant]] [[Tatrang]]. The planet was uninhabitable and considered to be commercially worthless.<ref name="PotG2" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tatrang III was first mentioned in the [[1992]] sourcebook ''[[Planets of the Galaxy, Volume Two]]'', which was written by [[John Terra]] for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="PotG2" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Tatrang system, and therefore Tatrang III, in grid square U-14.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
